first_config.input: own usernameBytes/codeTextBytes/directoryBytes/configurerBytes and explicit uint32 firstConfigWord. Actual attached nonshared U8/AB; caller-provided synthetic/authorized snapshots only.
first_config.limits: username0..16bytes, other raw fields0..4096bytes, Code digits1..10 with numeric0..14, no NUL, builtstringsNULinclusive<=32767bytes. No inferred ACP/path normalization/quoting.
first_config.lookup: section=lowercase32hex MD5(exactusernamebytes)+NUL; key=Game+originalCodeText+_Config+NUL; native default1. Account-derived metadata, not anonymous/authentication and not stored/displayed by UI.
first_config.condition: firstConfigWord==0 ->flag-clear; else rawConfigEXE length0 ->no-configuration-program; else configuration-requested. Whitespace/slashes/edge spaces of declared body preserved.
first_config.command: rawDirectory+backslash+rawConfigEXE+NUL; cwd rawDirectory+NUL. No Argsline or quoting; skip yields no config command/cwd. applicationName null/inheritHandlesfalse/flags0/environmentinherit.
first_config.outcome: not-requested continues without write; CreateProcess failure continues without write; created and wait not yet returned reports waiting/no continuation; after wait returns requests profile integer0 under same lookup and continuation. Native ignores wait code/process exit/write result in observed branch.
first_config.observations: processCreated/waitReturned are explicit caller timing snapshots, not invented protocol fields. Interpreter never performs wait or writes. All configurationVerified/authentication remain unverified.
first_config.ownership: Inputs copied, owned temporary buffers wiped on exit; output owned including account-derived identity. Caller handles output/copies privately; no full JS heap-erasure claim.

catalog.configurerText: decoded ConfigEXE leaf body without trim, alongside unchanged validated files.configuration metadata.
catalog.createLauncherCatalogFirstConfigPlan: Reparse/hashvalidate pair, validate current game/reference/optionalGalaxy ordinal, explicit directory/pathprofile and account/flag snapshots; rawConfigEXE/currentCode enter pure producer. Binding contains no username or lookup identity.
catalog.onlyRefreshWord: Optional own uint32 defaults0 for existing callers. CGCodes0/1/2/4/11 need resourceGroups only when word0; nonzero never reads the resource property. Other branches retain native clientCreationRequested semantics.

UI.control: launch-only-refresh defaultfalse and not persisted; own bool model, disabled/fake locked changes restored. Exposed value0/1 only to process plan.
UI.preparation: Changing clears old handoff and requires new preparation; selected patch/cache resources remain because content/binding unchanged. Checked skips FileList/candidate-name enumeration and still requires explicit valid directory; no silent mapping-only fallback.
UI.feedback: clientCreationRequested false ->only-refresh handoff,0resources,mapping length and explicit no game request. true ->existing fullcontext message. Neither authenticates, executes or refreshes a real official ticket.
UI.lifecycle: Config/region/Galaxy changes and pagehide reset choice. Account/text review locks the field; schema/resourcecache unchanged.
